property_summary: For any call to withdrawFees(asset, recipient), the amount of tokens actually transferred out of C to recipient equals the amount by which C's unclaimedFees[asset] decreased; the mutant zeroes the stored balance but transfers 0, so the transferred amount no longer equals the reduction in unclaimedFees for any nonzero fee.
change_summary: Report the fees amount as zero to the downstream transfer while still zeroing the stored balance.
